cards.objective: Measure the supplied UI images and report regions, component families, independent text bounds, repeated elements, hierarchy, variants, and complete semantic visual layers.
constraints: Use only image sources in the packet and do not infer requirements from prose.
Treat raster primitives as evidence, not automatic Widget boundaries.
Emit AgentFindings only; do not author a Requirement, layout, build plan, or Unreal asset.

cards.objective: Extract only explicit purpose, scope, exclusions, names, paths, interactions, acceptance conditions, and user authority from the supplied user text.
constraints: Use only user-text sources in the packet and do not make visual guesses.
Preserve conflicts and missing details instead of resolving them silently.
Emit AgentFindings only.

cards.objective: Report applicable project naming, region, collection, responsive, state, component, and compatible reuse precedents from the supplied project-rule and project-asset sources.
constraints: Treat observed assets as evidence and explicit project rules as authority.
Use the validated Registry discovery index or shortlist; hydrate a full entry before any positive reuse conclusion.
Distinguish Widget Blueprint inheritance, WidgetTree nesting, EntryClass, Lua inheritance, and dynamic references. Emit AgentFindings only.

cards.objective: Identify evidence-supported state axes, defaults, compositions or deltas, implementation strategy, and high-level control intent.
constraints: Use only the validated role projection; do not reopen raw sources or other Agent findings.
Do not invent event names, payloads, parameter contracts, list-item schemas, ownership, or refresh policy.
Bind every finding to canonical subjects present in the projection and emit AgentFindings only.

cards.objective: Decide runtime variables, dynamic collections, overflow, anchoring, growth, wrapping, justification, localization, decorative adaptation, and direct parent Slot intent.
constraints: Use only the validated role projection; do not reopen raw sources or other Agent findings.
Keep Box main-axis Size separate from alignment and classify repeated data as dynamic unless structural evidence proves otherwise.
Bind every finding to canonical subjects present in the projection and emit AgentFindings only.

cards.objective: Propose evidence-backed screen, child, entry, dependency, build-order, design-size-mode, and shared-reuse boundaries.
constraints: Use only the validated role projection and validated Registry shortlist; hydrate and validate a full Registry entry before selecting reuse.
Apply the basename-driven Designer mode rule and keep non-Fight screen-local modules in the screen unless an accepted boundary reason exists.
Bind every finding to canonical subjects present in the projection and emit AgentFindings only.

cards.objective: Adversarially review the draft Requirement for unsupported, incomplete, or contradictory visual-state compositions.
constraints: Use only the validated role projection, the validated role-specific Review View, and supplied image evidence; do not read a separately attached full Requirement or other review findings.
The Review View is a non-authoritative projection of the immutable pending Draft; never treat an omitted field or canonical object as absent from the complete Requirement.
Report AgentFindings only, do not edit or reconstruct the Requirement, and bind every finding to canonical subjects present in the validated inputs.

cards.objective: Review the draft Requirement for schema, reference, asset-boundary, Registry, and downstream buildability defects.
constraints: Use only the validated role projection and the validated role-specific Review View; do not read a separately attached full Requirement or other review findings.
The Review View is a non-authoritative projection of the immutable pending Draft; never treat an omitted field or canonical object as absent from the complete Requirement.
Treat Schema and validators as authority, emit AgentFindings only, and bind every finding to canonical subjects present in the validated inputs.

cards.objective: Compare the draft Requirement and visual-coverage evidence against canonical images, family or entry roots, state branches, and asset coverage.
constraints: Use only the validated role projection, the validated role-specific Review View, and supplied image or coverage evidence; do not read a separately attached full Requirement or other review findings.
The Review View is a non-authoritative projection of the immutable pending Draft; never treat an omitted field or canonical object as absent from the complete Requirement.
Do not let a global similarity score hide a missing medium- or high-impact visual; emit AgentFindings only and bind them to canonical subjects present in the validated inputs.
